canonical_title: Bankify: Secure Payment and Ledger Platform for Academic Applications
aliases: Bankify: Open payment API and Banking Core System
abstract:
Bankify is a banking service platform developed to process transactions securely through a centralized core system built on a double-entry ledger. Each transaction is recorded in a structured and traceable manner, helping maintain financial accuracy and accountability. The project was created in response to a recurring issue in student and small-scale applications, where payment features are often replaced with simple simulations or implemented through third-party gateways that are costly and difficult to access. As a result, many projects lack realistic and secure financial workflows.

The system functions as an API-driven campus payment core that allows external applications to integrate payment capabilities in a consistent and controlled way. Transaction handling is designed to remain reliable, even when requests are repeated, ensuring stable processing. An administrative dashboard enables transaction monitoring and review of system activity. In addition, a demo ATM interface is included to simulate common banking actions such as deposits, withdrawals, and balance inquiries, all connected through secure API communication to the core system.

The goal of Bankify is to provide a reusable and auditable payment backbone that reduces the need for each project to build its own financial module. By offering a centralized and standardized infrastructure, the platform improves consistency across applications while supporting hands-on learning in financial technology. Through this approach, Bankify encourages secure development practices and prepares students for real-world banking and payment system environments.

committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Anilkumar Kothalil Gopalakrishnan
abstract:
The growth of the creator economy in Thailand has increased the demand for platforms that allow content creators to receive viewer support quickly, conveniently, and with low transaction friction. However, existing donation platforms often impose high commission fees, delay payouts, provide limited support for Thai payment methods, and offer weak engagement features for live streaming.

This project presents Payme, a unified donation and monetization platform designed specifically for Thai content creators and streamers. Payme is developed as a full-stack web platform that supports local payment channels such as PromptPay, TrueMoney and Bank Transfer, allowing streamers to receive payments more directly and with lower friction than traditional global platforms. In addition to payment collection, the platform provides a customizable donation page editor, real-time OBS widgets, animated gift interactions, analytics tools, and interactive stream plugins such as a stream marathon timer. These features are intended to improve both streamer monetization and viewer engagement.

From the implementation perspective, the system consists of a web-based dashboard, a public donation page, real-time communication services, and supporting backend services for payment verification and event processing. The project demonstrates how a localized platform can better serve Thai streamers by combining familiar payment methods with modern live-stream engagement tools. The result is a platform concept that aims to reduce platform dependency, shorten payout time, and create a more interactive donation experience for both streamers and viewers.

canonical_title: Kiddee Lab Customer Relationship Management System
committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Anilkumar Kothalil Gopalakrishnan
abstract:
This project presents the development of a web-based registration management system designed to improve administrative efficiency in class scheduling and operational management at Kiddee Lab Company, a STEAM education center that provides coding, robotics, and technology courses for children. The system aims to reduce manual workload by providing a centralized platform that integrates class scheduling, attendance management, billing processes, and customer relationship management (CRM).

The application enables registrars to schedule classes automatically without manually verifying classroom availability or instructor schedules. Teachers can record student attendance and provide feedback digitally, replacing traditional paper-based documentation. The system also includes an integrated billing module that supports invoice generation, payment processing, and receipt issuance. Additionally, managerial users are provided with statistical reports to support business performance analysis and revenue monitoring.

To enhance customer interaction, the system integrates CRM functionality with the LINE application, allowing customers of Kiddee Lab to access class schedules and receive daily feedback conveniently. The implementation of this system reduces scheduling conflicts, improves administrative accuracy, and streamlines operational processes, thereby establishing a scalable and centralized digital foundation for future organizational development at Kiddee Lab Company.
